related.title: IEEE 802.1Qci：每流計量與突發超額
related.titleEn: IEEE 802.1Qci: per-stream metering and burst excess
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學阻塞預算2 µs；1522失敗、128通過；端到端延遲仍需加排程、傳播與處理。 qbu_bit_timeline.csv、合法切分點與阻塞上界 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 12.176 與變更 1.024 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching blocking budget2 microseconds:1522 fails and128 passes; end-to-end delay still includes scheduling, propagation and processing. qbu_bit_timeline.csv, permitted boundaries and blocking bound Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 12.176 and changed 1.024 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學整窗最少超額需為0；2500通過必要檢查、4500至少超1500；2500仍須逐時序檢查瞬間突發。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching aggregate minimum excess must be zero;2500 passes the necessary check while4500 exceeds by at least1500, and2500 still needs temporal burst analysis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成1 Gbit/s，不搶佔有效單元1522 bytes；啟用教學搶佔模型後128 bytes，所有假設開銷已計入有效長度。 名義式 1522*8/1e9*1e6 = 12.176 us；變更式 128*8/1e9*1e6 = 1.024 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在低優先幀開始後極短時間注入高優先事件，逐bit模擬直到下一合法中斷點；不得直接假設零等待。

合成桶2000 bytes、補充10000 bytes/s、窗0.1 s；到達2500，擾動4500 bytes。 名義式 max(0,2500-2000-10000*0.1) = 0 excess bytes；變更式 max(0,4500-2000-10000*0.1) = 1500 excess bytes。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將到達分為10個10 ms片段並維護桶餘額，檢查結果與整窗上界的關係；突發時刻不同可改變實際丟棄量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic1 Gbit/s with non-preemptible effective unit1522 bytes, changed to128 bytes in a preemption model; assumed overhead is included in these lengths. Nominal 1522*8/1e9*1e6 = 12.176 us; changed 128*8/1e9*1e6 = 1.024 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Inject a priority event immediately after a low-priority unit starts and simulate bits to the next valid interruption point; do not assume zero waiting.

Synthetic bucket2000 bytes, replenishment10000 bytes/s and0.1 s interval; arrivals2500 changed to4500 bytes. Nominal max(0,2500-2000-10000*0.1) = 0 excess bytes; changed max(0,4500-2000-10000*0.1) = 1500 excess bytes. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Simulate ten10 ms slices with bucket state and compare to the aggregate bound; different arrival timing can change actual dropped bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: EtherCAT Distributed Clocks：校正間隔與殘餘漂移
related.titleEn: EtherCAT Distributed Clocks: correction intervals and residual drift
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學阻塞預算2 µs；1522失敗、128通過；端到端延遲仍需加排程、傳播與處理。 qbu_bit_timeline.csv、合法切分點與阻塞上界 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 12.176 與變更 1.024 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching blocking budget2 microseconds:1522 fails and128 passes; end-to-end delay still includes scheduling, propagation and processing. qbu_bit_timeline.csv, permitted boundaries and blocking bound Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 12.176 and changed 1.024 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學峰值預算50 ns；1 ms通過、5 ms失敗；本模型未計固定不對稱與讀取誤差，交付時分開列出。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching peak budget50 ns:1 ms passes and5 ms fails; separately list omitted fixed asymmetry and timestamp error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成1 Gbit/s，不搶佔有效單元1522 bytes；啟用教學搶佔模型後128 bytes，所有假設開銷已計入有效長度。 名義式 1522*8/1e9*1e6 = 12.176 us；變更式 128*8/1e9*1e6 = 1.024 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在低優先幀開始後極短時間注入高優先事件，逐bit模擬直到下一合法中斷點；不得直接假設零等待。
合成殘餘頻差20 ppm，校正間隔1 ms；擾動5 ms，校正瞬間假設偏移歸零。 名義式 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns；變更式 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs累加0.2 ns直到下一次校正，畫鋸齒相位；量測校正前最大值而非週期平均值。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic1 Gbit/s with non-preemptible effective unit1522 bytes, changed to128 bytes in a preemption model; assumed overhead is included in these lengths. Nominal 1522*8/1e9*1e6 = 12.176 us; changed 128*8/1e9*1e6 = 1.024 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Inject a priority event immediately after a low-priority unit starts and simulate bits to the next valid interruption point; do not assume zero waiting.

Synthetic residual skew20 ppm, correction interval1 ms changed to5 ms, assuming zero offset immediately after correction. Nominal 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns; changed 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Accumulate0.2 ns every10 microseconds to the next correction and plot sawtooth phase; measure the pre-correction peak rather than average.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
